Internal test module of Terrabit, with no features. Its page on Odoo Apps checks how the store
renders a module description: external images served by terrabit.ro (the animated count of the
modules, SVG and GIF), inline SVG with animation, CSS animation, and the elements the store strips
(iframe, script). Do not install it.

## Rendering test matrix

Each card shows one technique; the text in brackets appears only when the store strips the element.
